en: If you feel the urge, come on back again.  Kukkukku.
Welcome in?  You started up a shop?
By any chance are you hurting for money?
Anyway please take a look at my wares.
Oh, by the way, I've placed an unusual item up for sale.  Take a look.

note: sfx: When the bordermoon collapses, the nearby miasma is purified.
